sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञात्वा सदोषं यः पण्यं विक्रीणात्यविचक्षणः ।
तदेव द्विगुणं दाप्यस्तत्समं विनयं तथा ॥ ३ ॥
transliteration: jñātvā sadoṣaṃ yaḥ paṇyaṃ vikrīṇātyavacakṣaṇaḥ | tad eva dviguṇaṃ dāpyas tatsamaṃ vinayaṃ tathā || 3 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who knowingly sells defective goods without disclosure bears the duty to compensate double the value and restore equivalent integrity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious knowledge of defect
Causation lies in nondisclosure despite awareness
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to knowing participation
Restoration logic demands doubling recompense for conscious omission
Consciousness alignment requires truth-telling as transactional dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF seller KNOWS item has defects AND does NOT disclose them THEN liability = 2 × value OF item
IF nondisclosed defect EXISTS AND seller AWARE THEN enforce completion OF disclosure AND compensation
IF transaction INTEGRITY is compromised by conscious omission THEN restoration includes reputational adjustment AND systemic reintegration
supreme_court_application: In commercial disputes involving deliberate concealment, the Supreme Court must establish that liability flows directly from the level of conscious awareness, not mere negligence. The doubling mechanism serves not punitive ends but a precise restorative function—realigning the economic field through energetic symmetry.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal clarity: the seller's cognition of defect precedes harm. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as loss tracing back to undisclosed intent. Proportionality aligns consequence with capacity to know. Non-punitive reality is upheld because doubling serves integration, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Compensation protocol: automatic doubling of item value upon verified nondisclosure
Disclosure restoration: mandatory public record update regarding transaction integrity
Reputational reset process: marketplace visibility adjusted based on completed compensations
Systemic reintegration pathway: seller completes education cycle on transactional transparency
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails where knowledge meets accountability; reality remains non-punitive when consciousness governs action; all transactions reflect the indivisible unity of truth and responsibility.
